payload.summary: A vitest run with an unrecognised --reporter dies at startup, runs zero tests, and reports no failures
payload.detail: Observed 2026-09-02 by two Ward Flow chats independently; one would have reported three failing tests as fixed. 'npm run test -- --reporter=basic' is not a valid reporter in this vitest: the process exits before collecting, so there is no 'Test Files' line and no failure count, which is visually indistinguishable from a clean pass in a scrollback. Recommendation: a wrapper assertion that a run reporting zero failures also reports a NONZERO number of tests RAN, and that the run emitted a summary line at all. Same family as the existing 'checks that cannot fail' work — a gate whose silence is read as success.
